definitions.explanation: A proposed plan for fixing or improving an existing problem, process, or situation. Compound of {改善|かいぜん} (improvement) + {案|あん} (proposal, draft).

examples.japanese: {改善案|かいぜんあん}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: I think up an improvement proposal.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}から{改善案|かいぜんあん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}した。
examples.english: We invited improvement proposals from the employees.

examples.japanese: {現状|げんじょう}の{問題点|もんだいてん}を{整理|せいり}したうえで{改善案|かいぜんあん}をまとめた。
examples.english: After sorting out the problems with the current situation, I put together an improvement proposal.

notes:
A proposal aimed at correcting a problem or making an existing process, product, or workflow better. Common in business and quality-management contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}を{出|だ}す・{提案|ていあん}する: to put forward an improvement proposal
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}をまとめる: to compile an improvement plan
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}を{検討|けんとう}する: to consider an improvement proposal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {企画案|きかくあん}: project proposal — proposes something new, rather than fixing what exists
- {対策|たいさく}: countermeasure — focuses on dealing with a specific problem
